div.head: Ine 74.1
div.ab: Gif he þonne þone ceap nylle foregesyllan, þonne mot hine se hlaford gefreogean; gildon siððan his magas þone wer, gif he mægburh hæbbe freo; gif he næbbe, heden his ðonne ða gefan.
Gif he þonne þone ceap nelle foregesellan, þonne mot hine se hlaford gefreogean; gielden siððan his mægas þone wer, gif he mægburg hæbbe freo; gif he næbbe, heden his þa gefan.
Si hoc captale nolit pro eo dare, tunc dominus eius liberum faciat eum; et soluant postea parentes eius weram illam (occisi), si cognationem habeat liberam; si non habeat, obseruent eum inimici sui.
Gif he þonne þone ceap nelle fore gesellan, þonne mot hine se hlaford gefreogean. Gieldan siððan his mægas þone wer, gif he mægburg hæbbe freo. Gif he næbbe, heden his þa gefan.

If, however, he does not wish to pay this amount for him, then the lord may free him. His kinsmen must afterwards pay the wer [for the slain man], if he has free kin. If he does not, then his enemies may take possession of him.

If, however, the lord will not pay this price for him, he must liberate him; afterwards his kinsmen must pay the wergeld, if he has a free kindred; if he has not [a free kindred], then his enemies may deal with him.
If, however, he will not pay the price for him, the master must then set him free; his kinsmen are then to pay the wergild if he has a free kindred; if he has not, the avengers are to deal with him.

Wenn er jedoch diesen Preis nicht für [ihn] hergeben will, dann darf ihn der Herr freigeben; es sollen alsdann seine [des Todtschlägers] Verwandte [für ihn] das Wergeld [des Erschlagenen an dessen Sippe] zahlen, falls jener freie Verwandtschaft besitzt; wenn er solche nicht besitzt, mögen sich die Rächer seiner bemächtigen.

But if he will not pay this price for [him], then the lord may set him free; his [the killer’s] kinsmen are then to pay the wergeld [of the slain man to his kin, for him], if he has free kindred; if he has none, let the avengers take hold of him.
